prompt_fields.subject: A jagged cluster of translucent violet-purple crystal shards radiating outward from a dense central core, like a spiky sea-urchin formed of glass, with an inner glow of magical light pulsing through the largest shards.
prompt_fields.contrast: First immovable/crystal catalog identity, no family collision. Reads immediately as an inorganic radiating crystal cluster rather than any humanoid or animal silhouette already in the catalog -- silhouette (radiating spiky cluster, no limbs, no base body) and hue (saturated violet-purple with an inner magical glow, distinct from any other catalog entry's palette) are the anchors.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at the style reference's own brightness, if anything a hair lighter, and never darker. No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures.
prompt_fields.palette: Translucent violet-to-deep-purple crystal shards with a pale lavender-white inner glow radiating from the densest core shards, subtle magenta highlight along the sharpest edges; dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, no glow or light spill allowed onto the disc itself -- the magical light stays contained inside the crystal shards.
